cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let the Callback Claim Credit
cards.instruction: Get recognition by returning to an early overlooked contribution when its importance becomes undeniable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't call a locksmith. Remember where I said we should keep the spare key?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Under the flowerpot. I told you it was a stupid place.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lift the pot, then. You can tell me that again when we're inside.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's too heavy. You lift; I'll get the key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lift. Once you've opened the door, try saying my idea was good.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 directs rescue through the dismissed key idea; A3 orders lifting but A5 accepts B revised roles to keep cooperation and win credit.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 recalls the hiding place; A3 acts on it; B4 supplies a workable swap and A5 agrees while using the resulting open door to seek recognition.

relationship.evidence: B4 cannot lift the heavy pot and offers useful key retrieval instead of a gratuitous argument.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes the once-dismissed idea creditable through B own successful unlocking, prompted by B4 role offer.

specificity.evidence: A1 locksmith, B2 spare key and B4 pot weight establish the task clearly.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 practical acceptance and pointed credit request are sufficient; the insult distinction is gone.
